hero_headline: Hey, I'm the person behind Cookie Digital.
story_p1: Cookie Digital Services was created to help local businesses move past outdated websites and replace them with clean, modern sites that better reflect the quality of their work. Many small businesses are still held back by slow, outdated, or poorly built websites that do not perform as they should.
story_p2: This is a one-person studio where every project is designed and coded directly by the developer. No outsourced teams, no handoffs, and no unnecessary layers. The result is consistent quality, clear communication, and full attention on every detail from start to finish.
story_p3: The focus is on building fast, user-friendly websites that are both visually strong and built to perform. If you are looking to improve your current site or start fresh, just reach out with a bit about your business and goals.
location_text: Based in the New York tri-state area, working primarily with businesses in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut. Open to projects beyond the region as well when it is a good fit.
working_text: Every project is handled directly from start to finish with no handoffs, no hidden teams, and no unnecessary complexity. Just clear communication, honest scope, and work focused on getting real results.
